development.what: the ARC-AGI-1 training tasks the vocabulary was invented on: the DSL and its combinators were written against the training split, the solved programs of bench/verdicts/grid.json (167 tasks, never scored) are collapsed into words and are the development corpus of the sleep, and the train pairs of the scored timeouts are mined for partial programs offered to the OTHER scored tasks

heldOut.what: the ARC-AGI-1 training tasks the fixed vocabulary timed out on, scored in every arm; a word is never offered to the task it was mined or collapsed from, test outputs are read only to grade; the library arm is cross fitted: fold f is scored with a library slept on the development programs and the solved programs of the invented arm on the other fold only, and a word the prior imagined carries the tasks that fed it as sources, so the own program of no scored task shaped a word it was offered

split.contaminated: the scored tasks are training tasks the DSL and its combinators were written against, and the train pairs of each scored task were mined for words offered to the other scored tasks, never to itself; no test output of a scored task fed a word it was offered

workUnit: work ms: capability/grid-invent.mjs WORK_MS weighs the counted applications and cells of a search

statement: On the 195 ARC-AGI-1 training tasks the fixed vocabulary timed out on (bench/verdicts/grid.json, so it solves 0 of them by construction), over 3 seeds (imagine-bench, s2, s3) each run 2 times under a budget of 1500 work ms per task per arm (counted work, not the wall clock), the invented arm solved 2, 1, 2 | 2, 1, 2 (run by run, seeds in that order) with a program that uses an invented primitive and the control, the null arm: as many random compositions of the fixed vocabulary and pairwise recombinations of the same memory as the invented library holds, under the same screen, the same admission of 32 words and the same 1500 work ms per task, on the same seeds in the same runs, solved 2, 2, 1 | 2, 2, 1. The mean lead is 0; the seed to seed band is 2 and the run to run band is 0, so the band is 2, set by the seed to seed band, and barMet is false: the mean lead 0 is not above the band 2, set by the seed to seed band. Run to run: run 2 repeated run 1 with 0 of 1755 task rows different and the mining identical; the wall clock safety stopped 18 solve jobs and 0 mining jobs. The second comparison is the library arm, DreamCoder's library learning applied to the invention step (routines compressed by description length from the development programs and the other fold's invented solves, the imagination's draw refit to them, so no fold is scored with a library its own tasks fed): it solved 2, 3, 1 | 2, 3, 1, a mean lead of 0.3333 over the null against a band of 2 set by the seed to seed band (beyond the band: false), and a mean lead of 0.3333 over the invented arm against a band of 3. Per task over the seeds and runs the invented arm was ahead of the null on 2 tasks and behind on 2 (sign test p 1). This is the TRAINING split and it is contaminated in the sense the split object states: the DSL and its combinators were written against it, and each scored task's train pairs were mined for words offered to the other scored tasks, never to itself; no scored task's test output fed a word it was offered.
